content: Intuitively, the first equation of Formula 24 tries to minimize the NER loss, but at the same time maximize the worker discriminator loss by the shared parameters of the common Bi-LSTM. Thus the resulting features of common Bi-LSTM actually attempt to hurt the worker discriminator, which makes these features worker independent since they are unable to distinguish different workers. The second equation tries to minimize the worker discriminator loss by its own parameter $\Theta ^{\prime }$ .
